entries.name: SixChannelComposite.ci.metallib
entries.role: Ink stroke rendering (pen, marker, watercolour textures)
entries.note: Blend modes and source-over compositing run on packed premultiplied pixels; the six-channel stroke composite of the reference is not implemented.

entries.name: SiriWaveArchive.metallib
entries.role: Siri wave and design library effects
entries.note: Siri wave animation archive shader; BifrOSt has no Siri wave visual. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled

entries.name: smct.metallib
entries.role: Effects shader of SMCT (app or system UI animation)
entries.note: SMCT UI effect shader (animations, gradients, glows); BifrOSt apps draw their own UI with the shape/glass pipeline and have no equivalent per-effect shader. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled

entries.name: SkyLightShaders.air64.metallib
entries.role: Window server compositing: blending, backdrop blur, shadows, colour management
entries.note: BifrOSt composites on the GPU with its own compose, shadow and Kawase blur shaders when a GPU presenter owns the backdrop; no layer effects such as masks, filters on layers or EDR tone mapping on the GPU. role inferred from the owning framework path; the metallib was not disassembled
